prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test produced a statistically significant win.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) harms performance, with 3 tests agreeing after noise correction (-3.7% overall).
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) harms performance, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-2.4% overall).
New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) harm performance, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-1.8% overall).
Evidence is thin or shows no clear effect for new home flows, adoption redesigns, path selection redesigns, and finish redesigns.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -0.8% after noise correction, 5 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -3.7% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -6.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +1.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Quick Selection Tip: Add a quick hint below the story screen header reassuring users that their path choice can be changed later anytime. (why: Mean time on choose_path step is 514s (vs 8s median), showing users get stuck hesitating over their initial choice.)
1: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Background Notification: Enable a system notification on the waiting screen to alert users when their desktop pet finished generating while minimized. (why: Waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, and support reported 3 cases of pets not appearing when users switch away.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Tip Carousel: Add an auto-rotating tip carousel component to the waiting screen sharing basic tips on pet controls and desktop behavior. (why: Home waiting step takes median 201s/mean 2336s, and support gets 3 emails about desktop pet controls being unclear after onboarding.)
3: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Friendly Guidance Header: Update headline and body on the upload_photos screen to clearly explain photo quality needs and prevent generation errors. (why: Support received 3 emails regarding custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion drops to 60.9%.)
4: [finish, hint] Home Intro Pet Desktop Visibility Hint: Add an explicit hint text on home_intro explaining how to summon or show the pet if it hides off-screen. (why: Finish conversion is 64.8% and support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on desktop or being hard to control.)
